title: Protect yourself in a committee
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: If a company a hundred times your size joined your committee, how would you protect yourself?

Jose said: you form a committee and that is where your biggest challenge will come from. People will say: I want to be the leader. You are a small company, and you sit with a company a hundred times bigger who says: I'll be the president of this committee, I'll talk to the senator.
How do you protect yourself? A student said: number one is to bring value. Jose said: everybody brings value. Number two, the student said, leverage by having the relationship with the politician.
Jose said: now we are getting somewhere. You have a special relationship with the senator and you keep that at bay. You are the messenger. You gain the trust of the president of the committee.

Another protection is a plan. You have a strategy that you sell in the first meetings with the industry people: this is the plan, already sold. We can add and subtract. You are negotiating on a platform.

They will want their Christmas list, he said. You add what they want. But you already have a specific strategy. At the beginning of negotiations you have to get the buy-in from the big industry players.

Number two: where will the red tape come from? Not people, Jose said, organizations. There will be a world of opposition. When you pass a law in the senate you will have senators who send missiles to you.
Identify who will come at you. A student named the contractors who lay rock and the dredging contractors. Jose said: those are the little guys. Who is bigger? Environmental organizations.
Who is bigger than you, and who could come against you?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write who could lead your committee.
Write how you protect your idea if a bigger company joins.
Write your relationship, and how you keep it separate.
Write your plan in one page, before the first meeting.
Write the organizations that could oppose you.

check.q: What did Jose call the role you keep with the senator?
What did Jose say you need before the first meeting with industry people?
choices: A plan that is already sold, which you can add to

check.q: What did Jose say red tape comes from?

recap: Be the messenger with a plan. Know who will oppose you.
